_comment: Marksman dev tool config (dev-only). Read by the /__marksman/config endpoint and the audio feature. inboxDir/assetsDir are where captures land (kept in sync with vite.config.ts). doneWhen holds this game's real gate commands, emitted verbatim into each capture. Set features.audio=true (via `new-game.mjs --audio` or the interactive prompt) to enable voice transcription; recording.whisperDir/model then point at a local whisper.cpp install. See src/marksman/README.md.
